profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under CIK 0001810997 and traded under the ticker XPEV. Its Spanish market site presents the brand as selling a fully electric range and says the company has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014. The models described there are the G6, G9 and P7⁺, which the company says combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the 800-volt SEPA 2.0 electric platform, allowing a charge from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three are described as carrying the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160.000 km.

The site is a lead-generation page for the Spanish market, inviting visitors to leave contact details to arrange a test drive or request more information. It states that the data controller is CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U., and offers optional consent to marketing communications by email, telephone, SMS, instant messaging platforms or in the vehicle where compatible. Financing examples are given for the G6 RWD Standard Range at a cash price of 41.122,71€ and for the G9 RWD Standard Range at 56.590,30€, with the G6 example carrying a debtor rate of 1,99% and an APR of 3,53%, and the G9 example a debtor rate of 4,99% and an APR of 6,76%. The financing is offered subject to review and approval by Open Bank, S.A.

No litigation, no AI products tracked separately, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
